records.name: Plague City and Ardougne Teleport
records.scope: Factual quest, item, combat, reward, and spell-unlock record only. It does not assess the value of Ardougne access, rank teleports, or recommend route timing.

quest_chain.skill_gate_note: Plague City has no listed skill requirement to start or complete.

required_combat.fact: No enemy defeat is listed as a completion requirement.

consumed_or_transformed.quantity: The current quest source lists dwellberries without a quantity; they are given to Alrena for the gas-mask step.

consumed_or_transformed.use: Given to Bravek for quest progression

consumed_or_transformed.supply_note: The source lists one to four buckets of water because a water source and bucket spawn are nearby.

tools_or_reusable_items.use: Make chocolate dust when supplying hangover-cure ingredients

player_supplied_inputs.stability_note: This record includes stable listed quest inputs only; travel aids and convenience supplies are intentionally omitted.

unlocks: Eligibility to use Ardougne teleport tablets

scroll_transition.permanent_unlock: Ardougne Teleport on the standard spellbook
scroll_transition.item_result: The scroll is consumed and converts to ashes when read.
scroll_transition.tablet_distinction: Completion of Plague City, rather than reading the scroll, is sufficient to use an Ardougne teleport tablet.

spell_transport.magic_level_boostability: Boostable for spell casting. This is a cast-time Magic requirement, not a quest-start or quest-completion requirement.
spell_transport.recurring_cost_note: The spell is a repeatable rune-consuming transport action, not a no-input permanent teleport.

records.name: Druidic Ritual through Eadgar's Ruse and Trollheim Teleport
records.scope: Factual prerequisite chain, stable player inputs, mandatory combat, fixed outcomes, and Trollheim Teleport mechanics only. It does not assess combat readiness, select a mountain route, or recommend route timing.

quest_chain.skill_gate_note: Druidic Ritual has no listed skill requirement to start or complete.

player_supplied_inputs.transition: Each raw meat is enchanted at the Cauldron of Thunder and the four enchanted meats are given to Sanfew.

required_combat.conditional_encounter: At the Taverley Dungeon gate, suits of armour can attack. The current quest source states that one level-19 suit attacks a player below combat level 55; no enemy defeat is listed as mandatory.

unlocks: Ability to use the Herblore skill

quest_chain.skill_gate_note: Death Plateau has no listed skill requirement to start or complete.

currency_and_optional_inputs.coins: The current source lists 60+ coins during the Harold step; the exact amount can vary with the selected dialogue or drink route.
optional: Blurberry special or premade blurb' sp

player_supplied_inputs.stability_note: Climbing boots are obtained during the quest and exchanged into the quest's spiked-boots state; they are not modeled here as an externally supplied input.

required_combat.fact: No enemy defeat is listed as a completion requirement.

unlocks: Ability to purchase and wear climbing boots from Tenzing

tools_or_reusable_items.alternative: 12 coins to buy a pair from Tenzing

player_supplied_inputs.stability_note: Food, armour, prayer, and ranged or Magic equipment are listed as recommendations rather than fixed hard item gates.

mandatory_encounters.source_note: The quest lists Dad among enemies to defeat; he can be safespotted.
The formal requirements explicitly require the ability to defeat a level-113 Troll General; the enemy can be safespotted.

required_combat.conditional_encounter: Twig and Berry, both level 71, can be pickpocketed with 30 Thieving (boostable). Players below that threshold or who fail the pickpocket can fight them instead; this is not a mandatory combat gate.

fixed_outcomes.replacement_rule: A lost law talisman can be repurchased from Dunstan for 1,000 coins.

transitive_quest_prerequisites: Death Plateau completed through Troll Stronghold

hard_skill_gates.use: Quest start and troll truth-potion creation

consumed_or_transformed.use: Cook troll thistle into dried thistle

tools_or_reusable_items.alternative: 12 coins to buy a pair from Tenzing

player_supplied_inputs.stability_note: The source notes extra logs and a tinderbox as helpful travel/backup supplies. They are not additional hard item gates.

required_combat.fact: No enemy defeat is listed as a completion requirement. Traversal can expose the player to mountain trolls and thrower trolls, but this does not create a stated kill requirement.

unlocks: Ability to grow and steal goutweed
Ability to trade goutweed to Sanfew for herbs
Ability to redirect a Teleport to House tablet to Trollheim with a scroll of redirection

spell_transport.destination: Top of Trollheim, outside Eadgar's cave
spell_transport.magic_level_boostability: Boostable for spell casting. This is a cast-time Magic requirement, not a quest-start or quest-completion requirement.

tablet_extension.outcome: The tablet can be redirected to Trollheim after Eadgar's Ruse.
tablet_extension.cost_classification: A redirected tablet remains a consumable teleport item.

spell_transport.recurring_cost_note: The spell is a repeatable rune-consuming transport action, not a no-input permanent teleport.

records.confidence: high for listed requirements and deterministic rewards; route traversal hazards and optional supplies are explicitly not treated as gates.
